DELIVERY.TITLE: Sending to a case system
DELIVERY.NONE_FAILED: Every submission has been sent or is waiting to be sent.
DELIVERY.LOAD_ERROR: The deliveries could not be loaded.
DELIVERY.RETRY_STARTED: We will send it again. This can take a minute.

ERROR.unreachable: The case system could not be reached on any attempt. Check that it is online and that the address is right. Retrying is safe.
ERROR.timeout: The case system did not answer in time on any attempt. Check that it is running. Retrying is safe.
ERROR.tls_error: The secure connection to the case system failed, for example because of its certificate. Ask its administrator to check it. Retrying is safe.
ERROR.not_allowed: The address of the service points to a private network, which we do not send to. A workspace admin must change the address, then you can retry.
ERROR.invalid_url: The address of the service is not valid. A workspace admin must correct it, then you can retry.
ERROR.redirect_refused: The address sends us somewhere else, and we do not follow that. A workspace admin must enter the final address, then you can retry.
ERROR.http_4xx: The case system refused the submission (HTTP {{status}}). Check the address, the sign-in and what the case system expects, then retry.
ERROR.http_5xx: The case system had an error (HTTP {{status}}) on every attempt. Try again later; retrying is safe.
ERROR.too_large: The submission was too large to send. It cannot be sent as it is.
ERROR.config_invalid: The settings this submission was first sent with no longer hold, so it cannot be sent safely and is not sent anywhere else. For example the service was removed or moved, the object type is outside the service's object types address, or a mapped question became a file question. Later submissions use the current settings.
ERROR.secret_unreadable: The stored secret (password, header value or token) cannot be read. A workspace admin must enter it again in the case system settings, then you can retry.
ERROR.answers_unreadable: The stored answers of this submission could not be read, so nothing could be sent. Retrying will not help. Ask your administrator to look into it.
ERROR.file_missing: An uploaded file of this submission is missing, so it cannot be sent as it is.
ERROR.disabled: Sending was turned off for this form, so nothing was sent. Turn it on again in the form's settings, then retry.
ERROR.internal_error: Something went wrong on our side. Retry; if it fails again, ask your administrator to look into it.
ERROR.lookup_failed: We couldn't confirm whether the record already exists in the Objects API, so nothing was sent again. Check the token's read permission and the object type, or use “Check connection” on the form, then retry. A retry looks first, so it cannot create a duplicate.
ERROR.http_4xx_schema: The object type did not accept the data (HTTP 400). The answers do not fit its schema. Check the mapped answers against the object type; a correction in the form's settings applies to later submissions, not to this one.
ERROR.http_4xx_token: The Objects API refused the token (HTTP {{status}}). Check that the token is right and may write to the object type, then retry.

DELIVERY.REGISTRATION_ERROR: The settings of this form could not be loaded, so the deliveries may be incomplete. Reload the page.

CHECK.ok: The connection works. The Objects API answered as expected. No record was read or created.
CHECK.not_configured: Save the object type, its version and at least one answer first.
CHECK.lookup_failed: The Objects API refused the look-up, or its answer could not be read. Check that the token has read permission on this object type.
CHECK.filter_not_supported: The Objects API does not check the search filter we use to find an existing object. A retry could then create a second object, so sending is not safe with it.
CHECK.secret_unreadable: The stored token cannot be read. Replace it in the workspace settings.
CHECK.config_invalid: The settings are incomplete. Save them again.

VARIABLE_CAUSE.no_rule: No rule sets this variable, so there was nothing to carry over.
VARIABLE_CAUSE.several_rules: More than one rule sets this variable, so it was not carried over.
VARIABLE_CAUSE.other_source: This variable is also filled by a prefill, a service or another action, so it was not carried over.
VARIABLE_CAUSE.duplicate_key: The file holds this variable more than once, so it was not carried over.
VARIABLE_CAUSE.not_numeric: This variable (type “{{dataType}}”) is not a number. Only numbers become calculated questions.
VARIABLE_CAUSE.condition: A rule sets this variable only when a condition holds, so it was not carried over.
VARIABLE_CAUSE.trigger_from_step: A rule sets this variable only from a given step on, so it was not carried over.
VARIABLE_CAUSE.operator: This variable is calculated with “{{operator}}”, which is not supported, so it was not carried over.
VARIABLE_CAUSE.operand: This variable is calculated in a way that is not supported (for example with text, or a calculation inside min or max).
VARIABLE_CAUSE.too_complex: The calculation of this variable is too long or nested too deeply.
VARIABLE_CAUSE.initial_value: This variable divides and starts with a value, so it was not carried over.
VARIABLE_CAUSE.source_missing: This variable uses “{{source}}”, which is not a question in the new form.
VARIABLE_CAUSE.source_not_number: This variable uses “{{source}}”, which is not a number question.
VARIABLE_CAUSE.source_in_group: This variable uses “{{source}}” from a repeating group.
VARIABLE_CAUSE.source_multiple: This variable uses “{{source}}”, which can hold several values.
VARIABLE_CAUSE.source_rewritten: This variable uses “{{source}}”, which a rule, a prefill or a script of the source form also sets.
VARIABLE_CAUSE.source_default: This variable uses “{{source}}”, which starts from a default value that was not carried over.
VARIABLE_CAUSE.source_conditional: This variable uses “{{source}}”. A rule can hide it; the source form then leaves it empty.
VARIABLE_CAUSE.depends_on_variable: This variable uses the variable “{{source}}”, which was not carried over.
VARIABLE_CAUSE.cycle: This variable depends on itself through other variables.
VARIABLE_CAUSE.order: This variable uses “{{source}}”, which a later rule sets.
VARIABLE_CAUSE.key_collision: This variable has the same key as a question.
VARIABLE_CAUSE.too_many: A form can hold at most 50 calculated questions (and 1000 questions in all). This one did not fit.
VARIABLE_CAUSE.rejected: The form editor did not accept this calculation.

WEBHOOKS.TITLE: Webhooks
WEBHOOKS.INTRO: Send the answers of the questions you choose to an https address of your own, as soon as someone submits this form. Each delivery is signed so your system can check that it came from here.
WEBHOOKS.NOTICE: Respondents are told, in the privacy panel of the form, that their answers are also sent to the host names listed here. Files are never sent. Answers leave this form only for the questions you pick.
WEBHOOKS.LOAD_ERROR: The webhooks could not be loaded. Reload the page to try again.

SECRET.TITLE: Signing secret for {{host}}
SECRET.ONCE: Copy this secret now and keep it somewhere safe. It is shown only once and cannot be shown again. If you lose it, create a new one with Rotate secret.
SECRET.LABEL: Signing secret
SECRET.COPY_FAILED: Copying was not possible here. The secret is selected: press Ctrl+C or Cmd+C.
SECRET.VERIFY: Every delivery carries an X-Bettercollected-Signature header: an HMAC-SHA256 of the timestamp, a dot and the exact body, made with this secret. Check it, and refuse old timestamps.

EMAIL_ACTIONS.TITLE: Email
EMAIL_ACTIONS.INTRO: Send an email when someone submits this form: to the form's team, and, if you choose, a copy to the person who answered. You write the words in English and Dutch; the language of the form picks which one is sent.
EMAIL_ACTIONS.NOTICE: Respondents are told, in the privacy panel of the form, that their answers are also emailed to the form's team and, if you turn it on, that they get a copy. Mail to the team only goes to members of this workspace. A copy to a respondent uses fixed wording, goes only to the address they typed in this submission, and is limited per address and form.
EMAIL_ACTIONS.NOT_CONFIGURED: This server has no mail server set up, so no email can be sent. Ask the person who runs it to configure one.
EMAIL_ACTIONS.LOAD_ERROR: The email actions could not be loaded. Reload the page to try again.

EDITOR.COPY: Send signed-in respondents a copy of their own answers
EDITOR.COPY_HINT: The copy goes to the verified email address of the account the respondent is signed in with (email code, Google or single sign-on), never to an address typed in an answer. It is in fixed wording that you do not write, with the answers of the questions below, and limited to a few per address and hour. Anonymous respondents get no copy: not those who are not signed in, and not those who choose to submit anonymously.

EDITOR.COPY_UNVERIFIED: This form does not ask respondents to sign in, so anonymous respondents get no copy, and no copies will be sent to them. Turn on "Require verified identity" in this form's settings so every respondent signs in before answering.
